Money is not the root of all evil. You were told it wrong.

Kevin Trudeau explains that the old line is misquoted. The letter was written to people who focused only on making money, and who were willing to use people and do bad things to get it.

So the warning was never about money itself. It was about the love of money.

What did you grow up believing about money?
